pythonFunction.name: create_portal_account
pythonFunction.description:
Creates an online portal account for the identified customer and sends a verification email.
Needs an identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase
while it runs.

Args:
    name: Customer's full name (REQUIRED).
    email: Email address for the portal account, confirmed by the customer (REQUIRED).
    address: Service address on the account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and verification_email_hint (masked).
